## 2. Core Professional Profile & Biography

Muhammed Ajmal U K specializes in building production-ready AI tools, high-performance web applications, scalable REST APIs, and cross-platform mobile applications. He is known for combining AI capabilities (such as Google Gemini API, OpenAI LLMs, autonomous agents, and prompt engineering) with full-stack engineering (Python/Flask, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Flutter, Firebase, Supabase).

He is also an expert in technical SEO and digital distribution, having grown his proprietary AI creative tools platform (**ToolPix**) to over **600,000+ organic Google Search clicks** and **14,000,000+ search impressions**.

## 4. Software Portfolio & Featured Projects

### A. ToolPix AI Platform
- **Live URL**: https://toolpix.pythonanywhere.com
- **Case Study**: https://ajmal.uthakkan.in/blog/how-toolpix-reached-600k-organic-clicks
- **Category**: AI Tools & Web Productivity
- **Stack**: Python, Flask, PIL/Pillow, JavaScript, HTML5/CSS3, SEO Optimization
- **Key Metrics & Impact**: 600K+ organic search clicks, 14M+ search impressions, 350K+ processed images.
- **Description**: An AI-powered suite of web utilities including background remover, photo enhancer, color palette extractor, SVG converter, and design templates. Built with lightweight serverless architecture and optimized for Core Web Vitals.

### B. KallanCop — Mobile Multiplayer Game
- **Google Play Store**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ajmal.kallancop
- **Case Study**: https://ajmal.uthakkan.in/blog/publishing-kallancop-on-google-play
- **Category**: Mobile Gaming (Social Deduction)
- **Stack**: Flutter, Dart, Local Wi-Fi / Hotspot Sockets, Android SDK
- **Key Features**: Zero internet required, local peer-to-peer multiplayer, privacy-respecting offline architecture, custom role generation, dynamic scoring.

### C. DVMA — Dementia Virtual Memory Assistant
- **Project Detail**: https://ajmal.uthakkan.in/projects/dvma
- **Case Study**: https://ajmal.uthakkan.in/blog/building-dvma-gemini-ai-dementia-care
- **Category**: Healthcare & AI Assistance
- **Stack**: Flutter, Google Gemini AI API, Firebase Auth & Firestore, Text-to-Speech, Geofencing
- **Key Features**: Multimodal photo recognition for family members, calm conversational AI memory companion, real-time emergency geofencing, caregiver dashboard.

### D. CodePix
- **Live URL**: https://codepix.uthakkan.in
- **Category**: EdTech & Developer Tools
- **Stack**: Python, Flask, Monaco Editor, Docker, WebSockets
- **Description**: Interactive gamified coding challenges and sandboxed code execution platform designed to teach foundational programming and data structures.

### E. Climbo
- **Live URL**: https://climbo.uthakkan.in
- **Category**: Browser Gaming
- **Stack**: HTML5 Canvas, Vanilla JavaScript, Custom 2D Physics Engine
- **Description**: High-performance physics-based 2D side-scrolling browser racing game designed to run smoothly at 60 FPS on any device without plugins.

### F. Explore Together
- **Case Study**: https://ajmal.uthakkan.in/blog/explore-together-final-year-project-to-product
- **Category**: Travel & Social Networking
- **Stack**: Flutter, Firebase, Google Gemini API, Cloud Functions
